summoners_path.name: Summoner's Path
summoners_path.description: Begin your journey at the Academy of Summoning Arts. Master the fundamentals of summoning and forge your fate.

test_arena.name: Test Arena
test_arena.description: Test battles for core combat mechanics. Uses fixed decks - no collection required.

caravan_01.name: Traveling Merchant
caravan_01.description: A cheerful merchant has set up camp along the path. Browse wares and spend your hard-earned gold on new cards and supplies.

path_fork.name: Choose Your Path
path_fork.description: The road ahead splits into two distinct paths. Choose the challenge that suits your style.

elite.label: Elite Path
elite.description: Harder battles with level caps. Better rewards but greater risk. Cards above the cap are normalized.

standard.label: Standard Path
standard.description: Normal difficulty battles. Consistent rewards with no level restrictions.

first_trial.name: The First Trial
first_trial.description: Your journey begins here. Face a simple opponent and learn the basics of summoning combat. Victory earns you your first card choice.

second_challenge.name: Second Challenge
second_challenge.description: With two cards at your disposal, test new combinations against a stronger foe. Another card choice awaits the victor.

third_trial.name: Third Trial
third_trial.description: Your deck grows. Face a worthy opponent and prove your developing skills. Choose wisely from the rewards offered.

elite_01.name: Elite Trial
elite_01.description: A difficult battle with level caps. Your cards will be normalized to level 3. Success brings rare rewards.

standard_01.name: Path of Growth
standard_01.description: A standard battle along the reliable path. Build your strength steadily with common rewards.

act1_boss.name: The Guardian
act1_boss.description: The first major challenge of your journey. A powerful foe guards the path forward. Defeat them to complete Act 1.

arena_earth_sprite.name: Earth Sprite Test
arena_earth_sprite.description: Test the Earth Sprite unit. A rocky elemental with a sapling on its head.

arena_puff.name: Puff Test
arena_puff.description: Test the Puff unit. A mischievous wind cloud that blows gusts at enemies.

arena_fire_wisp.name: Fire Wisp Test
arena_fire_wisp.description: Test the Fire Wisp unit. Watch it bob and float across the battlefield.

arena_cloud_swarm.name: Cloud Swarm Test
arena_cloud_swarm.description: Test the Cloud Swarm unit. Six clouds drift together in pairs across the battlefield.

arena_mana_bolt.name: Mana Bolt Test
arena_mana_bolt.description: Test the Mana Bolt spell. A purple energy bolt that strikes the nearest enemy.

charge_intro.speaker: Merlin
charge_intro.line_1: A wild slime blocks your path. This one looks... different. Tougher.

charge_tanky_slime.speaker: Merlin
charge_tanky_slime.line_1: By the stones! This slime's hide is incredibly thick. Your units' attacks barely scratch it!

charge_explain.speaker: Merlin
charge_explain.line_1: Use your Charge card! Command a unit to rush past the slime to the enemy core. Sometimes victory isn't about fighting—it's about strategy.

merriweather_greeting.speaker: Mr. Merriweather
merriweather_greeting.line_1: Why, hello there, young summoner! What wonderful timing! I'm Mr. Merriweather, traveling merchant and purveyor of fine magical goods. I've journeyed far to bring these quality wares to aspiring summoners such as yourself!

merriweather_offer.speaker: Mr. Merriweather
merriweather_offer.line_1: Please, take your time browsing! Every item in my collection has been carefully curated. I pride myself on offering only the finest selections at fair prices. After all, helping young summoners succeed is its own reward!

merriweather_closing.speaker: Mr. Merriweather
merriweather_closing.line_1: Do let me know if anything catches your eye! I'll be in the area for a while—there are several other summoners I'm hoping to assist today. Such a joy to support the next generation of summoners!

merlin_summoner_intro.speaker: Merlin
merlin_summoner_intro.line_1: The time has come, Initiate. Step into the circle.
merlin_summoner_intro.line_2: Every summoner carries an elemental spark. Yours is about to ignite.
merlin_summoner_intro.line_3: Choose your path wisely... though fate does favor the bold.

merlin_first_card_intro.speaker: Merlin
merlin_first_card_intro.line_1: Welcome to the Academy, Initiate. I am Merlin, your Headmaster.
merlin_first_card_intro.line_2: You stand at the beginning of your journey as a summoner—a path of great power and greater responsibility.
merlin_first_card_intro.line_3: Here at the Academy, we teach one principle above all: choices have consequences. What you bind, stays bound.
merlin_first_card_intro.line_4: Your first choice lies before you. Select your starting companion—Fire Elemental or Earth Sprite.
merlin_first_card_intro.line_5: Choose with intention, Initiate. This decision is permanent, as all true summoning must be.

first_trial_intro.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_intro.line_1: Welcome to the training grounds, Initiate.
first_trial_intro.line_2: Your affinity chosen, your companion bound—now we put theory into practice.
first_trial_intro.line_3: Before you lies a simple trial. A single slime awaits beyond.
first_trial_intro.line_4: Show me you understand the fundamentals. Victory here earns your place among the Academy's summoners.

first_trial_card_explain.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_card_explain.line_1: These cards summon units to defend your base.
first_trial_card_explain.line_2: Each shows its mana cost, attack, and health.
first_trial_card_explain.line_3: You start with 10 mana—enough for several summons.

first_trial_core_explain.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_core_explain.line_2: Beat them before they reach your base. Destroy their core to win!

first_trial_enemy_appears.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_enemy_appears.line_2: If it reaches your base, you'll take damage.

first_trial_play_prompt.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_play_prompt.line_1: You try—play a card to defend!
first_trial_play_prompt.line_2: Drag it onto the battlefield to summon your unit.

simple_greeting.speaker: Friendly Wizard
simple_greeting.line_2: Welcome to the world of card battles.
simple_greeting.line_3: May your deck be strong and your mana plentiful!

chain_start.speaker: Old Sage
chain_start.line_1: This is the beginning of a longer story...
chain_start.line_2: It will continue in the next dialogue.

chain_end.speaker: Old Sage
chain_end.line_1: And here we are at the conclusion.
chain_end.line_2: Dialogue chains allow for multi-part conversations!
chain_end.line_3: This is very useful for storytelling.

choice_example.speaker: Mysterious Merchant
choice_example.line_1: Ah, another traveler seeks my wares!
choice_example.line_2: Will you join me on this journey?
